Method of Attack: Screen locker ransomware that locks the screen and requests a $30 ransom payment
Locks screen preventing access to files and applications but leaves data intact
Generates MD5 hash of MachineName to identify victim
Contacts C&C server to retrieve updated ransomware version
Runs SystemLock.exe from startup folder to lock screen
Displays ransom note demanding payment via Skype account 'arizonacode'
Kills processes like taskmgr, procexp, skype, chrome, steam, MicrosoftEdge, regedit, msconfig, utilman, cmd, explorer, certmgr, control, cscript to prevent closing
Shows popup on ALT+F4 attempt to close locker
Uses C&C server text files to verify payment and unlock system
Later versions encrypt files with .deria extension
Threatens file deletion on reboot if ransom not paid in newer versions
Discoverer: Karsten Hahn, G Data malware analyst
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with .NET Framework 4.5 or higher (not Windows XP)
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of unlock-everybody.txt file on C&C server
MD5 hash of MachineName used as HWID
